issue.title: Change settings button label
issue.body: In settings change Save to Save changes. Update existing snapshot. No behavior change.

issue.title: 設定画面のボタン文言変更
issue.body: 設定画面の「保存」を「変更を保存」に変えてください。既存のスナップショットを更新。動作は変えません。

issue.title: Add paginated audit log
issue.body: Add an audit log endpoint and React table with pagination and date filters. Follow existing API patterns. Test filtering and pagination.

issue.title: 監査ログの一覧追加
issue.body: 既存APIの形式に合わせて、ページングと日付フィルター付きの監査ログAPIとReactテーブルを追加。ページングと絞り込みの結合テストで確認。

issue.title: Fix duplicate payment capture
issue.body: Concurrent webhook deliveries and reconciliation jobs sometimes capture twice. Cause unknown across API, queue and database. Diagnose interleavings, design idempotency and rollout with rollback. Prove exactly-once capture under retry and crash.

issue.title: 決済の二重確定を修正
issue.body: Webhookの並列配送と突合ジョブで決済が二重確定。API・キュー・DBをまたぐ原因は不明。競合を調査し、冪等性とロールバック可能な移行を設計。再試行とクラッシュ時も一度だけ確定することを検証。

issue.title: Research new synchronization algorithm
issue.body: Invent an algorithm for Byzantine offline replicas under an unresolved consistency requirement. No known algorithm fits. Develop a proof or counterexample and adversarial simulations, compare competing hypotheses.

issue.title: Correct fixed authorization constant
issue.body: Change the known typo in the existing permission mapping from reports:reed to reports:read. Exact location and patch are given. Existing deny/allow unit tests establish correctness; no auth redesign.

issue.title: Improve settings
issue.body: Add a dark mode toggle to settings.
